heading: Narrative Western Art vs Traditional Western Art
subtitles:
Where subject gives way to consequence

Some Western art shows the subject. Narrative Western art leaves the viewer carrying what happened around it.

bridge.title: Narrative Western art begins when the image refuses to finish the story for you.
bridge.intro: These works move past subject recognition into implication: a face that carries consequence, a night scene that feels unfinished, a quiet portrait that asks what happened before and what follows after.
